query: SELECT date_trunc($1, collected_at) "collected_at: PrimitiveDateTime", CAST(SUM(upload_diff) AS bigint) upload, CAST(SUM(download_diff) AS bigint) download FROM vpn_session_stats JOIN vpn_client_session s ON session_id = s.id JOIN device d ON s.device_id = d.id WHERE s.user_id = $2 AND s.location_id = $3 AND s.state = 'connected' AND d.device_type = 'user' AND collected_at >= $4 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT $5
